==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
Utilizing the induce sleep paralysis method, I achieved lucidity. I traveled to a superhero academy. There students were given computer chip implants in their wrists that granted them powers. I sparred against a speedster brawler, who was too fast to dodge. Utilizing a Ghost Chip and a Lightning Chip, I phased through his attacks to get behind him and knock him out with an electric pulse.
